purpose: Behaviour checks for semantic grouping: the ten cases the product must get right. Used during development and in unit tests, never for headline numbers.
provenance: CONSTRUCTED, NOT REAL CHAT. Written by Claude (the model building the system) to exercise specific behaviours; the intended groups are the author's intent, not an independent judgement. Real-chat windows with independently drafted labels are in evals/semantic/windows/.
rule: Same as the real windows: a shared cluster id means the same specific meaning; `x` never pairs; `unsure` is excluded.
